$description: Closed value set for each primitive of ShapeProfile. Single source of truth: planner prompt renders from this, validators read from this, code enums are generated from this. Adding a new value = JSON edit + one PR. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-intelligent-rich-forge.md.

layout.hero.description: What dominates the first view above the fold.

layout.primaryInteraction.description: What the user is mostly doing on the primary surface.

auth.surface.description: How the user is asked to authenticate.

nav.back.description: How the user retreats from a screen.

data.readShape.description: How primary data is presented to the user.

data.denormalization.description: How aggressively foreign keys are flattened for display.

identity.usageMode.description: Who uses this app and how often.

safe_defaults.$comment: Used by shape_profile_detector.py as the last-resort fallback when no LLM signal AND no keyword signal is available. Matches today's implicit default output shape so a missing-API-key fallback still generates a working (if unadventurous) app.
